method.title: How Future Me works
method.level: Your level on each ADVANCE skill is the best level among the Kafa'a skills mapped to it and their competency's core skill, from your skills passport (qualifications, courses, assessments, JPMs and ratings). Security skills never count.
method.factor: Skills that transfer from APR-1400 work count in full, skills that adapt count at half, and new skills count zero.
method.index: Readiness index = 100 × the sum of (factor × level up to 3, divided by 3) ÷ the number of ADVANCE skills in the family. The overall index is the mean of the six families.
method.ceiling: The ceiling is the most your current skills can carry over; the gap above it is new learning.
method.bridges: Bridge plan: role fit (1 your role, 0.6 within two career steps, 0.3 other) × (index points still available + 5). Learning suggestions are ranked by the deterministic gap-closure engine.
method.roles: Concept roles: half for the link to the roles they start from, half for your skill overlap.
method.mirror: Kafa'a is a mirror, not an authority: these indices are SIMULATED, are not a qualification or an assessment, and imply no deployment decision.
